decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-226 MODIFY establishing Lit Protocol gating and automatic ownership verification; removing offline download does not require any additional change to that gating state.
The offline-download link is not part of this candidate's current state, and the primary read action can continue directing users to the ebook viewer.
Eliminating offline download does not necessarily replace PDF.js or alter the read-only reader; the Lit Protocol gate can precede or wrap the existing viewer.
The PDF remains stored through Pinata and IPFS, and removal of a user-facing offline-download option does not change the storage protocol, provider, or takedown requirement.
The About-page state contains no offline-download promise or ebook-access detail that must change because of this decision.
The current FAQ attributes concern prize and fiat-buyer reward mechanics and contain no offline PDF download instruction requiring removal.
Fiat-buyer dashboard and reward access remain valid unchanged; they are independent of whether the ebook can be downloaded for offline reading.
Referral-code identity and display locations are unrelated to the ebook's offline-download availability.
Background wallet provisioning for fiat buyers is unaffected by the ebook access and download decision.
The Transak payment and mint flow is independent of whether NFT holders receive a downloadable PDF or access the ebook only through a gated viewer.
Prize-winner email notification behavior contains no ebook download or reader-access semantics.
Small Block prize funding, ticketing, selection, and execution rules are semantically unaffected by the offline PDF download decision.
